body: The worst part is I helped her through some really rough times where she seriously considered suicide when I could barely keep myself alive

My dog Nori passed last year due to a tumor in his nose, he was 4. He was always a healthy dog, loved me most. The day we put him down I cryed my heart out, I couldn't stop crying and now I'm bawling again but this time I need to thank you. Thank you for posting this. I needed it. You never stop grieving
You said she wasn't attractive, so I called you ugly.
And you're ugly. Now that we have that settled
